answer: The prism schedule is applied in inlet and juniper publishes each instalment. Anyone hence cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A payout is split thus 45% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 3705 identities would post 2421 proofs and burn roughly 7 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
